Full-time Project Coordinator position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Seven Hills, NSW 2147. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:

•	Full-Time Project Coordinator
•	$79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
Legend Australia (CABAC) is a leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of electrical products, cable connectivity solutions and infrastructure products servicing the electrical wholesale, commercial and infrastructure sectors across Australia. The company is committed to delivering quality products, reliable service and innovative solutions to its customers.

As a Project Coordinator at Legend Australia, you will coordinate electrical product and infrastructure projects, ensuring documentation, schedules, procurement activities and stakeholder communications are managed efficiently. This position requires excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Coordinate project plans, schedules and delivery activities for electrical products and infrastructure projects.
•	Prepare, maintain and control project documentation, technical records, schedules and correspondence throughout the project lifecycle.
•	Liaise with Project Managers, engineers, suppliers, contractors and customers to ensure milestones, quality standards and delivery deadlines are achieved.
•	Respond to project enquiries and assist in resolving technical, scheduling and operational issues affecting project delivery.
•	Review project variations, coordinate approvals and ensure all scope changes are accurately documented and communicated.
•	Monitor contractor and supplier performance, identify variations against project scope and report findings to management.
•	Prepare project submissions, progress updates, meeting minutes and management reports to support informed decision-making.
•	Collect, analyse and interpret project data to monitor performance, identify risks and recommend process improvements.
•	Support procurement activities by coordinating materials, equipment and delivery schedules to meet project requirements.
•	Provide timely advice to management on project matters requiring attention and implement approved actions to facilitate successful project outcomes.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as a Project Coordinator.
•	Strong project coordination and organisational skills.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

result.description:
Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.
